thread:
sarah.ae: Heads-up — AscendAI POC just escalated to execs. CISO put HSM + 'no public egress' on the table, procurement asking for VPC-only deployment, and legal wants SOC2 artifacts + subprocessor list. They also want committed throughput numbers before next-week exec sync. Need owners and an internal plan by EOD.

mike_infra: Copy. Which region & model family? Any BYOHSM requirement or can we use our KMS-backed option? Also need expected QPS and avg tokens to size nodes.

lina_security: We can assemble SOC2 pack and subprocessor list today. For HSM — we have two paths: 1) Dedicated Private deployment with our HSM integration (longer lead), or 2) Customer-provided HSM via peering (customers must expose endpoint). Need CISO to confirm which.

devon_sales_ops: Scheduled customer call with their CISO tomorrow 10am PT. I'll send calendar invite to everyone. Customer said: "HSM for key custody, no public egress, proof of isolation." Also asked for a written cost + timeline for each option.

sarah.ae: Owners: mike -> infra path + sizing, lina -> security artifacts, ben -> legal for contract edits, julia -> exec sync + pricing signoff. Deadline: internal readiness doc by 17:00 PT. If anyone can't hit that, flag now. :exclamation:

legal_ben: Will review DPA/SLA asks. If they want HSM in contract we need to scope liability + attestation language. Can we get an example of their regulatory requirement (reg name or control)?

cto_julia: If procurement insists on SLA + committed throughput we can offer Dedicated with 99.9% SLA + reserved GPU units. We need realistic perf numbers to map to node counts. @mike_infra can you do a quick node estimate for 100 qps with avg 8k context?

mike_infra: Quick calc (very rough):
```
assumptions:
  qps = 100
  avg_tokens_per_request = 512
  token_rate_per_node ~= 12,000 tok/s (A100-optimized, unquantized)

compute:
  tok/sec_needed = qps * avg_tokens_per_request / 1s = 100 * 512 = 51,200 tok/s
  nodes_needed = ceil(51,200 / 12,000) = 5 nodes
```
With quantization + KV cache hit (customer caches prefixes) we could drop to ~3 nodes. Network peering + private VPC adds ~2-3 days for infra + approvals.

devon_sales_ops: Pricing question: what's typical uplift for private HSM + dedicated nodes? Need a ballpark to include in customer-facing doc.

sarah.ae: Ballpark: 18% uplift for private HSM and ~25% uplift for fully Dedicated reserved nodes on M-term deals. We'll refine with finance but include that as preliminary.

lina_security: Action for call: we should bring a short checklist for the CISO: subprocessor list, SOC2 timeline, HSM options, network architecture diagram. I'll draft checklist and security one-pager by EOB. :memo:

deploybot: Infra blueprint created: https://confluence.redwood/.well/ascendai-poc-blueprint (private) — includes VPC outline and peering steps.

sarah.ae: Thanks team. Next steps for EOD doc: 1) Mike -> final node estimate + rough timeline for private deploy, 2) Lina -> SOC2 + subprocessor doc, 3) Ben -> contract language bullets, 4) Devon -> slide w/ options & ballpark pricing. I'll assemble into single readout for the exec sync. Ping me if blocked. :thumbsup:

mike_infra: Noted. I'll post a short sizing table and ETA (infra tasks + approvals) by 16:00 PT.

legal_ben: I'll drop contract bullets in this thread by 15:30. Need copy of their regulator text if they provided.

devon_sales_ops: Adding meeting invite attendees: sarah, lina, mike, ben, julia, and customer CISO. Please accept.

sarah.ae: Accepting — pushing to exec if we have all artifacts. If any critical blocker pops up, escalate to @cto_julia immediately.

cto_julia: I'll be on the call for exec-level questions. If we commit to Dedicated nodes, we can prioritize capacity but need customer signoff on budget.

mike_infra: Posted sizing table: https://confluence.redwood/ascendai-sizing (private). Short notes: peering + HSM onboarding = ~5 business days if nothing else blocks.

sarah.ae: Great work. We'll close internal readiness doc and share before the 10am PT call.
